items.title: EPSS Surge: CVE-2026-75650
items.analysis: EPSS exploitation probability for CVE-2026-75650 surged from 35% to 99% (percentile 100%), indicating a significant increase in predicted or observed exploitation activity for this 2026-era vulnerability. It is not (yet) in CISA KEV — this signal typically precedes KEV listing and press coverage. Adobe Commerce is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

items.title: EPSS Surge: CVE-2026-59310 (VMware ESXi/vCenter)
items.analysis: EPSS exploitation probability for CVE-2026-59310 surged from 0% to 62% (percentile 99%), indicating a significant increase in predicted or observed exploitation activity for this 2026-era vulnerability. It is not (yet) in CISA KEV — this signal typically precedes KEV listing and press coverage. VMware vCenter contains a directory traversal vulnerability in the Syslog server. A malicious actor with network access to vCenter may exploit this issue to execute arbitrary code.

items.title: EPSS Surge: CVE-2026-102489
items.analysis: EPSS exploitation probability for CVE-2026-102489 surged from 22% to 50% (percentile 99%), indicating a significant increase in predicted or observed exploitation activity for this 2026-era vulnerability. It is not (yet) in CISA KEV — this signal typically precedes KEV listing and press coverage. Zammad versions 6.3.0 to 6.5.4 are vulnerable a session hijack vulnerability that leads to remote code execution as the zammad user. The bug is also present in version 7.0.0 to version 7.1.2, but not exploitable due to changes in the underlying framework.
